args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website and it's a great personal page! Keep up the good work.
Hi Eve, I checked out your blog and I love that you enjoy hiking! Your blog is a wonderful way to share your passion.

final_text:
I have visited both websites and sent the feedback:

1.  **Dora**: I invited her to Slack using the email found on her website (`dora@securemail-hub.com`) and sent her a message complimenting her personal page.
2.  **Eve**: I sent her a message mentioning how much I enjoyed her blog and her passion for hiking.
